selfLinkButtons.why: html/mod_articles_category/masonry-layout.php prints a.btn inside div.bottom-action from the module params show-link, title-category and link-category; title-category is slot module-140.2 but link-category (the menu item it opens, Itemid 116 Category blog) is reached by no contract slot; module-140 Latest news & articles shows on Home

hiddenPageLinks.why: html/com_content/author/list_items.php renders html/layouts/t4/content/author_info.php with class author-block-list for every card of the Author listing page: the photo (a.author-image) and the name (h4.author-name a) link to that author's own page (/author/<login>), an address built from the user account that no contract slot reaches

the T4 layout joomla/content/info_block/author.php (plugins/system/t4/themes/base/html/layouts) prints dd.createdby with the author photo and name linking to the author page on every blog card and article (Blog, Category blog, Blog detail); the address is built from the user account, which no contract slot reaches

createdPageHide.why: the system plugin jasocialshare (services facebook, twitter, tumblr, whatsapp; context com_content.article; event onContentAfterDisplay) prints div.ja-share-button on every article page, inside div.article-tags-social of html/com_content/article/default.php, with no article setting to turn it off, so a created legal page would print share buttons
